result.rationale: In app/models/embeddable_host.rb, `before_validation do self.host.sub!(...) end` runs unconditionally; `validates_format_of :host` does not protect nil, and the controller assigns `host.host = params[:embeddable_host][:host]` which can be nil (e.g., direct API call omitting host), so `sub!` on nil raises NoMethodError → 500 instead of a validation error.
